type.enhancement: A new feature or an improvement
type.question: A question, or more information or discussion is needed

area.security: Security: keys, sign-in, encryption, permissions, or attacks
area.performance: Speed, latency, memory, or resource use is the point of the issue
area.hardware: Support for particular hardware: GPUs, accelerators, or devices
area.runtime: llama.cpp or another inference runtime itself: installing, starting, or running it, or its GPU backends. Not every issue that involves a model
area.networking: Networking: discovery, pairing, remote access, the relay, or connections between computers
area.orchestration: How a request is planned and routed: agents, tools, model choice, or placement across computers
area.api: The control API or the OpenAI-compatible API, as programs call them
area.translation: Text in a language other than English, or a new language
area.tests: Tests, CI checks, benchmarks, or the quality suite
